# Machine-source research ledger

The deliverable's numerical improvement comes from the reconstructed factory, coordinated gauges, 92-pivot kernel and complete asynchronous allocation. None of the following is credited with an additional gain in the selected program.

| Source concept | Concrete adaptation | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Word RAM reads operands before overwriting a destination | Capture a pair sum and the still-old second operand between two shears, then decode the changed basis | Constructed; the best snapshot candidate reached 88 pivots but lost to the selected 92-pivot program |
| Machine execution preserves locations outside an injective live-register renaming | Reuse retired factory storage for own-output rows, with exact frame restoration | Later retired rows do not fit the output frames; the explicit downward transitions cost more rank than the available deficit |
| Exact Turing return/restoration and word substitution with additive cost | Merge an exterior pending factor into a helper's first or final recursive call | A sufficient rule is proved; the tested coordinated-rank2 baseline has no eligible entry or exit site |
| Reversible finite-state normalization | Track repeated pending axes modulo four and emit the explicit parity remainder and translation | Sufficient identity proved; the paid finite-stock screen selected no overlaps |
| Persistent reserved workspace and continuation composition | Shorter controllers with paid spills; larger finite replica pipelines | The tested programs did not improve the complete price |
| Actual machine read dependency | Recompute entrance eligibility at the first observer after retiming | A valid 89-pivot candidate lost to the selected program |

These are bounded outcomes, not universal barriers. The useful sufficient transformations, exact coalescing gate and source hashes are retained in research-notes/. Missing typed DAG ports are reported; reading a Lean source is not kernel certification. A polynomial RAM-to-Turing simulation alone cannot preserve an improvement to this near-linear exponent, so no such simulation is used as a free speedup.

For a future successful machine-derived change, emit the actual modified arbitrary-dirt operator, pay restoration and routing, rebuild the literal physical assignment and compare the complete rank moment. Saving a register or a local instruction alone does not establish a larger kappa.
